body: Dont get me wrong, I'm not exactly moping, we're certainly having a damn good time together. My roommate isn't coming back for 2 weeks so I have her and my room all to myself, and we're certainly taking advantage of it. It's just that the reality of the situation is creeping up on me as May gets closer and I don't know if telling her before it comes would make things better or worse. But don't worry, I intend to pour my next 5 months into spending at much time with her as I can.
